summary: Arauco, a Chilean foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K/A-style notice (US equivalent: Form 8-K current report) on August 18-20, 2026, disclosing receipt of an independent evaluator's report from EY Consultores Limitada regarding an Equity Support Agreement with parent Empresas Copec S.A. The Aug 11 material fact called an Extraordinary Shareholders Meeting, akin to a special meeting notice, for approval. The report is available on arauco.com from Aug 20 until September 10. No price, stake, premium, or board recommendation stated. Watch shareholder approval and regulatory compliance risk.
